verses.arabicText: تَبَارَكَ ٱلَّذِى نَزَّلَ ٱلْفُرْقَانَ عَلَىٰ عَبْدِهِۦ لِيَكُونَ لِلْعَـٰلَمِينَ نَذِيرًا
verses.transliteration: Tabāraka alladhī nazzala l-fur'qāna ʿalā ʿabdihi liyakūna lil'ʿālamīna nadhīrā
verses.translation: Blessed is the One Who sent down the Standard to His servant, so that he may be a warner to the whole world

verses.arabicText: ٱلَّذِى لَهُۥ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَمْ يَتَّخِذْ وَلَدًا وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُۥ شَرِيكٌ فِى ٱلْمُلْكِ وَخَلَقَ كُلَّ شَىْءٍ فَقَدَّرَهُۥ تَقْدِيرًا
verses.transliteration: Alladhī lahu mul'ku s-samāwāti wal-arḍi walam yattakhidh waladaw-walam yakul-lahu sharīkun fī l-mul'ki wakhalaqa kulla shayin faqaddarahu taqdīrā
verses.translation: ˹Allah is˺ the One to Whom belongs the kingdom of the heavens and the earth, Who has never had ˹any˺ offspring, nor does He have a partner in ˹governing˺ the kingdom. He has created everything, ordaining it precisely

verses.arabicText: وَٱتَّخَذُوا۟ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ ءَالِهَةً لَّا يَخْلُقُونَ شَيْـًٔا وَهُمْ يُخْلَقُونَ وَلَا يَمْلِكُونَ لِأَنفُسِهِمْ ضَرًّا وَلَا نَفْعًا وَلَا يَمْلِكُونَ مَوْتًا وَلَا حَيَوٰةً وَلَا نُشُورًا
verses.transliteration: Wa-ittakhadhū min dūnihi ālihatal-lā yakhluqūna shayaw-wahum yukh'laqūna walā yamlikūna li-anfusihim ḍarraw-walā nafʿaw-walā yamlikūna mawtaw-walā ḥayataw-walā nushūrā
verses.translation: Yet they have taken besides Him gods who cannot create anything but are themselves created. Nor can they protect or benefit themselves. Nor can they control life, death, or resurrection

verses.arabicText: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ إِنْ هَـٰذَآ إِلَّآ إِفْكٌ ٱفْتَرَىٰهُ وَأَعَانَهُۥ عَلَيْهِ قَوْمٌ ءَاخَرُونَ ۖ فَقَدْ جَآءُو ظُلْمًا وَزُورًا
verses.transliteration: Waqāla alladhīna kafarū in hādhā illā if'kun if'tarāhu wa-aʿānahu ʿalayhi qawmun ākharūna faqad jāū ẓul'maw-wazūrā
verses.translation: The disbelievers say, “This ˹Quran˺ is nothing but a fabrication which he made up with the help of others.” Their claim is totally unjustified and untrue

verses.arabicText: وَقَالُوٓا۟ أَسَـٰطِيرُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ ٱكْتَتَبَهَا فَهِىَ تُمْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِ بُكْرَةً وَأَصِيلًا
verses.transliteration: Waqālū asāṭīru l-awalīna ik'tatabahā fahiya tum'lā ʿalayhi buk'rataw-wa-aṣīlā
verses.translation: And they say, “˹These revelations are only˺ ancient fables which he has had written down, and they are rehearsed to him morning and evening.”

verses.arabicText: قُلْ أَنزَلَهُ ٱلَّذِى يَعْلَمُ ٱلسِّرَّ فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ غَفُورًا رَّحِيمًا
verses.transliteration: Qul anzalahu alladhī yaʿlamu s-sira fī s-samāwāti wal-arḍi innahu kāna ghafūrar-raḥīmā
verses.translation: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “This ˹Quran˺ has been revealed by the One Who knows the secrets of the heavens and the earth. Surely He is All-Forgiving, Most Merciful.”

verses.arabicText: وَقَالُوا۟ مَالِ هَـٰذَا ٱلرَّسُولِ يَأْكُلُ ٱلطَّعَامَ وَيَمْشِى فِى ٱلْأَسْوَاقِ ۙ لَوْلَآ أُنزِلَ إِلَيْهِ مَلَكٌ فَيَكُونَ مَعَهُۥ نَذِيرًا
verses.transliteration: Waqālū māli hādhā r-rasūli yakulu ṭ-ṭaʿāma wayamshī fī l-aswāqi lawlā unzila ilayhi malakun fayakūna maʿahu nadhīrā
verses.translation: And they say ˹mockingly˺, “What kind of messenger is this who eats food and goes about in market-places ˹for a living˺? If only an angel had been sent down with him to be his co-warner

verses.arabicText: أَوْ يُلْقَىٰٓ إِلَيْهِ كَنزٌ أَوْ تَكُونُ لَهُۥ جَنَّةٌ يَأْكُلُ مِنْهَا ۚ وَقَالَ ٱلظَّـٰلِمُونَ إِن تَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا رَجُلًا مَّسْحُورًا
verses.transliteration: Aw yul'qā ilayhi kanzun aw takūnu lahu jannatuy-yakulu min'hā waqāla ẓ-ẓālimūna in tattabiʿūna illā rajulam-masḥūrā
verses.translation: or a treasure had been cast down to him, or he had had a garden from which he may eat!” And the wrongdoers say ˹to the believers˺, “You are only following a bewitched man.”

verses.arabicText: ٱنظُرْ كَيْفَ ضَرَبُوا۟ لَكَ ٱلْأَمْثَـٰلَ فَضَلُّوا۟ فَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ سَبِيلًا
verses.transliteration: Unẓur kayfa ḍarabū laka l-amthāla faḍallū falā yastaṭīʿūna sabīlā
verses.translation: See ˹O Prophet˺ how they call you names! So they have gone so ˹far˺ astray that they cannot find the ˹Right˺ Way

verses.arabicText: تَبَارَكَ ٱلَّذِىٓ إِن شَآءَ جَعَلَ لَكَ خَيْرًا مِّن ذَٰلِكَ جَنَّـٰتٍ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَـٰرُ وَيَجْعَل لَّكَ قُصُورًۢا
verses.transliteration: Tabāraka alladhī in shāa jaʿala laka khayram-min dhālika jannātin tajrī min taḥtihā l-anhāru wayajʿal laka quṣūrā
verses.translation: Blessed is the One Who—if He wills—can give you far better than ˹all˺ that: gardens under which rivers flow, and palaces as well

verses.arabicText: بَلْ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِٱلسَّاعَةِ ۖ وَأَعْتَدْنَا لِمَن كَذَّبَ بِٱلسَّاعَةِ سَعِيرًا
verses.transliteration: Bal kadhabū bil-sāʿati wa-aʿtadnā liman kadhaba bil-sāʿati saʿīrā
verses.translation: In fact, they deny the Hour. And for the deniers of the Hour, We have prepared a blazing Fire

verses.arabicText: إِذَا رَأَتْهُم مِّن مَّكَانٍۭ بَعِيدٍ سَمِعُوا۟ لَهَا تَغَيُّظًا وَزَفِيرًا
verses.transliteration: Idhā ra-athum mim-makānin baʿīdin samiʿū lahā taghayyuẓaw-wazafīrā
verses.translation: Once it sees them from a distance, they will hear it fuming and growling

verses.arabicText: وَإِذَآ أُلْقُوا۟ مِنْهَا مَكَانًا ضَيِّقًا مُّقَرَّنِينَ دَعَوْا۟ هُنَالِكَ ثُبُورًا
verses.transliteration: Wa-idhā ul'qū min'hā makānan ḍayyiqam-muqarranīna daʿaw hunālika thubūrā
verses.translation: And when they are tossed into a narrow place inside ˹Hell˺, chained together, then and there they will cry out for ˹instant˺ destruction

verses.arabicText: لَّا تَدْعُوا۟ ٱلْيَوْمَ ثُبُورًا وَٰحِدًا وَٱدْعُوا۟ ثُبُورًا كَثِيرًا
verses.transliteration: Lā tadʿū l-yawma thubūraw-wāḥidaw-wa-id'ʿū thubūran kathīrā
verses.translation: ˹They will be told,˺ “Do not cry only once for destruction, but cry many times over!”

verses.arabicText: قُلْ أَذَٰلِكَ خَيْرٌ أَمْ جَنَّةُ ٱلْخُلْدِ ٱلَّتِى وُعِدَ ٱلْمُتَّقُونَ ۚ كَانَتْ لَهُمْ جَزَآءً وَمَصِيرًا
verses.transliteration: Qul adhālika khayrun am jannatu l-khul'di allatī wuʿida l-mutaqūna kānat lahum jazāaw-wamaṣīrā
verses.translation: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “Is this better or the Garden of Eternity which the righteous have been promised, as a reward and ˹an ultimate˺ destination

verses.arabicText: لَّهُمْ فِيهَا مَا يَشَآءُونَ خَـٰلِدِينَ ۚ كَانَ عَلَىٰ رَبِّكَ وَعْدًا مَّسْـُٔولًا
verses.transliteration: Lahum fīhā mā yashāūna khālidīna kāna ʿalā rabbika waʿdam-masūlā
verses.translation: There they will have whatever they wish for, forever. That is a promise ˹to be sought after˺, binding on your Lord.”

verses.arabicText: وَيَوْمَ يَحْشُرُهُمْ وَمَا يَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ فَيَقُولُ ءَأَنتُمْ أَضْلَلْتُمْ عِبَادِى هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ أَمْ هُمْ ضَلُّوا۟ ٱلسَّبِيلَ
verses.transliteration: Wayawma yaḥshuruhum wamā yaʿbudūna min dūni l-lahi fayaqūlu a-antum aḍlaltum ʿibādī hāulāi am hum ḍallū s-sabīl
verses.translation: ˹Watch for˺ the Day He will gather them along with what they used to worship besides Allah, and ask ˹the objects of worship˺, “Was it you who misled these servants of Mine, or did they stray from the Way ˹on their own˺?”

verses.arabicText: قَالُوا۟ سُبْحَـٰنَكَ مَا كَانَ يَنۢبَغِى لَنَآ أَن نَّتَّخِذَ مِن دُونِكَ مِنْ أَوْلِيَآءَ وَلَـٰكِن مَّتَّعْتَهُمْ وَءَابَآءَهُمْ حَتَّىٰ نَسُوا۟ ٱلذِّكْرَ وَكَانُوا۟ قَوْمًۢا بُورًا
verses.transliteration: Qālū sub'ḥānaka mā kāna yanbaghī lanā an-nattakhidha min dūnika min awliyāa walākim-mattaʿtahum waābāahum ḥattā nasū dh-dhik'ra wakānū qawman būrā
verses.translation: They will say, “Glory be to You! It was not right for ˹others like˺ us to take any lords besides You, but You allowed enjoyment for them and their forefathers ˹for so long˺ that they forgot ˹Your˺ remembrance and became a doomed people.”

verses.arabicText: فَقَدْ كَذَّبُوكُم بِمَا تَقُولُونَ فَمَا تَسْتَطِيعُونَ صَرْفًا وَلَا نَصْرًا ۚ وَمَن يَظْلِم مِّنكُمْ نُذِقْهُ عَذَابًا كَبِيرًا
verses.transliteration: Faqad kadhabūkum bimā taqūlūna famā tastaṭīʿūna ṣarfaw-walā naṣraw-wamay-yaẓlim minkum nudhiq'hu ʿadhāban kabīrā
verses.translation: ˹The doomed will be told˺, “Your gods have clearly denied your claims. So now you can neither ward off ˹the punishment˺ nor get any help.” And whoever of you does wrong, We will make them taste a horrible punishment

verses.arabicText: وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَا قَبْلَكَ مِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ إِلَّآ إِنَّهُمْ لَيَأْكُلُونَ ٱلطَّعَامَ وَيَمْشُونَ فِى ٱلْأَسْوَاقِ ۗ وَجَعَلْنَا بَعْضَكُمْ لِبَعْضٍ فِتْنَةً أَتَصْبِرُونَ ۗ وَكَانَ رَبُّكَ بَصِيرًا
verses.transliteration: Wamā arsalnā qablaka mina l-mur'salīna illā innahum layakulūna ṭ-ṭaʿāma wayamshūna fī l-aswāqi wajaʿalnā baʿḍakum libaʿḍin fit'natan ataṣbirūna wakāna rabbuka baṣīrā
verses.translation: We never sent any messenger before you ˹O Prophet˺, who did not eat food and go about in market-places. We have made some of you a trial for others. Will you ˹not then˺ be patient? And your Lord is All-Seeing

verses.arabicText: ۞ وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَرْجُونَ لِقَآءَنَا لَوْلَآ أُنزِلَ عَلَيْنَا ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ أَوْ نَرَىٰ رَبَّنَا ۗ لَقَدِ ٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ فِىٓ أَنفُسِهِمْ وَعَتَوْ عُتُوًّا كَبِيرًا
verses.transliteration: Waqāla alladhīna lā yarjūna liqāanā lawlā unzila ʿalaynā l-malāikatu aw narā rabbanā laqadi is'takbarū fī anfusihim waʿataw ʿutuwwan kabīrā
verses.translation: Those who do not expect to meet Us say, “If only the angels were sent down to us, or we could see our Lord!” They have certainly been carried away by their arrogance and have entirely exceeded all limits

verses.arabicText: يَوْمَ يَرَوْنَ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةَ لَا بُشْرَىٰ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُجْرِمِينَ وَيَقُولُونَ حِجْرًا مَّحْجُورًا
verses.transliteration: Yawma yarawna l-malāikata lā bush'rā yawma-idhil-lil'muj'rimīna wayaqūlūna ḥij'ram-maḥjūrā
verses.translation: ˹But˺ on the Day they will see the angels, there will be no good news for the wicked, who will cry, “Keep away! Away ˹from us˺!”

verses.arabicText: وَقَدِمْنَآ إِلَىٰ مَا عَمِلُوا۟ مِنْ عَمَلٍ فَجَعَلْنَـٰهُ هَبَآءً مَّنثُورًا
verses.transliteration: Waqadim'nā ilā mā ʿamilū min ʿamalin fajaʿalnāhu habāam-manthūrā
verses.translation: Then We will turn to whatever ˹good˺ deeds they did, reducing them to scattered dust

verses.arabicText: أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْجَنَّةِ يَوْمَئِذٍ خَيْرٌ مُّسْتَقَرًّا وَأَحْسَنُ مَقِيلًا
verses.transliteration: Aṣḥābu l-janati yawma-idhin khayrum-mus'taqarraw-wa-aḥsanu maqīlā
verses.translation: ˹But˺ on that Day the residents of Paradise will have the best settlement and the finest place to rest

verses.arabicText: وَيَوْمَ تَشَقَّقُ ٱلسَّمَآءُ بِٱلْغَمَـٰمِ وَنُزِّلَ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ تَنزِيلًا
verses.transliteration: Wayawma tashaqqaqu s-samāu bil-ghamāmi wanuzzila l-malāikatu tanzīlā
verses.translation: ˹Watch for˺ the Day the heavens will burst with clouds, and the angels will be sent down in successive ranks

verses.arabicText: ٱلْمُلْكُ يَوْمَئِذٍ ٱلْحَقُّ لِلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ۚ وَكَانَ يَوْمًا عَلَى ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ عَسِيرًا
verses.transliteration: Al-mul'ku yawma-idhil-l-ḥaqu lilrraḥmāni wakāna yawman ʿalā l-kāfirīna ʿasīrā
verses.translation: True authority on that Day will belong ˹only˺ to the Most Compassionate. And it will be a hard day for the disbelievers

verses.arabicText: وَيَوْمَ يَعَضُّ ٱلظَّالِمُ عَلَىٰ يَدَيْهِ يَقُولُ يَـٰلَيْتَنِى ٱتَّخَذْتُ مَعَ ٱلرَّسُولِ سَبِيلًا
verses.transliteration: Wayawma yaʿaḍḍu ẓ-ẓālimu ʿalā yadayhi yaqūlu yālaytanī ittakhadhtu maʿa r-rasūli sabīlā
verses.translation: And ˹beware of˺ the Day the wrongdoer will bite his nails ˹in regret˺ and say, “Oh! I wish I had followed the Way along with the Messenger

verses.arabicText: يَـٰوَيْلَتَىٰ لَيْتَنِى لَمْ أَتَّخِذْ فُلَانًا خَلِيلًا
verses.transliteration: Yāwaylatā laytanī lam attakhidh fulānan khalīlā
verses.translation: Woe to me! I wish I had never taken so-and-so as a close friend

verses.arabicText: لَّقَدْ أَضَلَّنِى عَنِ ٱلذِّكْرِ بَعْدَ إِذْ جَآءَنِى ۗ وَكَانَ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنُ لِلْإِنسَـٰنِ خَذُولًا
verses.transliteration: Laqad aḍallanī ʿani dh-dhik'ri baʿda idh jāanī wakāna sh-shayṭānu lil'insāni khadhūlā
verses.translation: It was he who truly made me stray from the Reminder after it had reached me.” And Satan has always betrayed humanity

verses.arabicText: وَقَالَ ٱلرَّسُولُ يَـٰرَبِّ إِنَّ قَوْمِى ٱتَّخَذُوا۟ هَـٰذَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ مَهْجُورًا
verses.transliteration: Waqāla r-rasūlu yārabbi inna qawmī ittakhadhū hādhā l-qur'āna mahjūrā
verses.translation: The Messenger has cried, “O my Lord! My people have indeed received this Quran with neglect.”

verses.arabicText: وَكَذَٰلِكَ جَعَلْنَا لِكُلِّ نَبِىٍّ عَدُوًّا مِّنَ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ ۗ وَكَفَىٰ بِرَبِّكَ هَادِيًا وَنَصِيرًا
verses.transliteration: Wakadhālika jaʿalnā likulli nabiyyin ʿaduwwam-mina l-muj'rimīna wakafā birabbika hādiyaw-wanaṣīrā
verses.translation: Similarly, We made enemies for every prophet from among the wicked, but sufficient is your Lord as a Guide and Helper

verses.arabicText: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَوْلَا نُزِّلَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلْقُرْءَانُ جُمْلَةً وَٰحِدَةً ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ لِنُثَبِّتَ بِهِۦ فُؤَادَكَ ۖ وَرَتَّلْنَـٰهُ تَرْتِيلًا
verses.transliteration: Waqāla alladhīna kafarū lawlā nuzzila ʿalayhi l-qur'ānu jum'lataw-wāḥidatan kadhālika linuthabbita bihi fuādaka warattalnāhu tartīlā
verses.translation: The disbelievers say, “If only the Quran had been sent down to him all at once!” ˹We have sent it˺ as such ˹in stages˺ so We may reassure your heart with it. And We have revealed it at a deliberate pace

verses.arabicText: وَلَا يَأْتُونَكَ بِمَثَلٍ إِلَّا جِئْنَـٰكَ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَأَحْسَنَ تَفْسِيرًا
verses.transliteration: Walā yatūnaka bimathalin illā ji'nāka bil-ḥaqi wa-aḥsana tafsīrā
verses.translation: Whenever they bring you an argument, We come to you with the right refutation and the best explanation

verses.arabicText: ٱلَّذِينَ يُحْشَرُونَ عَلَىٰ وُجُوهِهِمْ إِلَىٰ جَهَنَّمَ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ شَرٌّ مَّكَانًا وَأَضَلُّ سَبِيلًا
verses.transliteration: Alladhīna yuḥ'sharūna ʿalā wujūhihim ilā jahannama ulāika sharrum-makānaw-wa-aḍallu sabīlā
verses.translation: Those who will be dragged into Hell on their faces will be in the worst place, and are ˹now˺ farthest from the ˹Right˺ Way

verses.arabicText: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا مُوسَى ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ وَجَعَلْنَا مَعَهُۥٓ أَخَاهُ هَـٰرُونَ وَزِيرًا
verses.transliteration: Walaqad ātaynā mūsā l-kitāba wajaʿalnā maʿahu akhāhu hārūna wazīrā
verses.translation: We certainly gave Moses the Book and appointed his brother Aaron as his helper

verses.arabicText: فَقُلْنَا ٱذْهَبَآ إِلَى ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا فَدَمَّرْنَـٰهُمْ تَدْمِيرًا
verses.transliteration: Faqul'nā idh'habā ilā l-qawmi alladhīna kadhabū biāyātinā fadammarnāhum tadmīrā
verses.translation: We had ordered ˹them˺, “Go to the people who would deny Our signs.” Then We annihilated the deniers entirely

verses.arabicText: وَقَوْمَ نُوحٍ لَّمَّا كَذَّبُوا۟ ٱلرُّسُلَ أَغْرَقْنَـٰهُمْ وَجَعَلْنَـٰهُمْ لِلنَّاسِ ءَايَةً ۖ وَأَعْتَدْنَا لِلظَّـٰلِمِينَ عَذَابًا أَلِيمًا
verses.transliteration: Waqawma nūḥil-lammā kadhabū r-rusula aghraqnāhum wajaʿalnāhum lilnnāsi āyataw-wa-aʿtadnā lilẓẓālimīna ʿadhāban alīmā
verses.translation: And when the people of Noah rejected the messengers, We drowned them, making them an example to humanity. And We have prepared a painful punishment for the wrongdoers

verses.arabicText: وَعَادًا وَثَمُودَا۟ وَأَصْحَـٰبَ ٱلرَّسِّ وَقُرُونًۢا بَيْنَ ذَٰلِكَ كَثِيرًا
verses.transliteration: Waʿādaw-wathamūdā wa-aṣḥāba r-rasi waqurūnan bayna dhālika kathīrā
verses.translation: Also ˹We destroyed˺ ’Ȃd, Thamûd, and the people of the Water-pit, as well as many peoples in between

verses.arabicText: وَكُلًّا ضَرَبْنَا لَهُ ٱلْأَمْثَـٰلَ ۖ وَكُلًّا تَبَّرْنَا تَتْبِيرًا
verses.transliteration: Wakullan ḍarabnā lahu l-amthāla wakullan tabbarnā tatbīrā
verses.translation: For each We set forth ˹various˺ lessons, and We ultimately destroyed each

verses.arabicText: وَلَقَدْ أَتَوْا۟ عَلَى ٱلْقَرْيَةِ ٱلَّتِىٓ أُمْطِرَتْ مَطَرَ ٱلسَّوْءِ ۚ أَفَلَمْ يَكُونُوا۟ يَرَوْنَهَا ۚ بَلْ كَانُوا۟ لَا يَرْجُونَ نُشُورًا
verses.transliteration: Walaqad ataw ʿalā l-qaryati allatī um'ṭirat maṭara s-sawi afalam yakūnū yarawnahā bal kānū lā yarjūna nushūrā
verses.translation: They have certainly passed by the city ˹of Sodom˺, which had been showered with a dreadful rain ˹of stones˺. Have they not seen its ruins? But they do not expect to be resurrected

verses.arabicText: وَإِذَا رَأَوْكَ إِن يَتَّخِذُونَكَ إِلَّا هُزُوًا أَهَـٰذَا ٱلَّذِى بَعَثَ ٱللَّهُ رَسُولًا
verses.transliteration: Wa-idhā ra-awka iy-yattakhidhūnaka illā huzuwan ahādhā alladhī baʿatha l-lahu rasūlā
verses.translation: When they see you ˹O Prophet˺, they only make fun of you, ˹saying,˺ “Is this the one that Allah has sent as a messenger

verses.arabicText: إِن كَادَ لَيُضِلُّنَا عَنْ ءَالِهَتِنَا لَوْلَآ أَن صَبَرْنَا عَلَيْهَا ۚ وَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ حِينَ يَرَوْنَ ٱلْعَذَابَ مَنْ أَضَلُّ سَبِيلًا
verses.transliteration: In kāda layuḍillunā ʿan ālihatinā lawlā an ṣabarnā ʿalayhā wasawfa yaʿlamūna ḥīna yarawna l-ʿadhāba man aḍallu sabīlā
verses.translation: He would have almost tricked us away from our gods, had we not been so devoted to them.” ˹But˺ soon they will know, when they face the punishment, who is far astray from the ˹Right˺ Way

verses.arabicText: أَرَءَيْتَ مَنِ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَـٰهَهُۥ هَوَىٰهُ أَفَأَنتَ تَكُونُ عَلَيْهِ وَكِيلًا
verses.transliteration: Ara-ayta mani ittakhadha ilāhahu hawāhu afa-anta takūnu ʿalayhi wakīlā
verses.translation: Have you seen ˹O Prophet˺ the one who has taken their own desires as their god? Will you then be a keeper over them

verses.arabicText: أَمْ تَحْسَبُ أَنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ يَسْمَعُونَ أَوْ يَعْقِلُونَ ۚ إِنْ هُمْ إِلَّا كَٱلْأَنْعَـٰمِ ۖ بَلْ هُمْ أَضَلُّ سَبِيلًا
verses.transliteration: Am taḥsabu anna aktharahum yasmaʿūna aw yaʿqilūna in hum illā kal-anʿāmi bal hum aḍallu sabīlā
verses.translation: Or do you think that most of them listen or understand? They are only like cattle—no, more than that, they are astray from the ˹Right˺ Way

verses.arabicText: أَلَمْ تَرَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ كَيْفَ مَدَّ ٱلظِّلَّ وَلَوْ شَآءَ لَجَعَلَهُۥ سَاكِنًا ثُمَّ جَعَلْنَا ٱلشَّمْسَ عَلَيْهِ دَلِيلًا
verses.transliteration: Alam tara ilā rabbika kayfa madda ẓ-ẓila walaw shāa lajaʿalahu sākinan thumma jaʿalnā sh-shamsa ʿalayhi dalīlā
verses.translation: Have you not seen how your Lord extends the shade—He could have simply made it ˹remain˺ still if He so willed—then We make the sun its guide

verses.arabicText: ثُمَّ قَبَضْنَـٰهُ إِلَيْنَا قَبْضًا يَسِيرًا
verses.transliteration: Thumma qabaḍnāhu ilaynā qabḍay-yasīrā
verses.translation: causing the shade to retreat gradually

verses.arabicText: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلَّيْلَ لِبَاسًا وَٱلنَّوْمَ سُبَاتًا وَجَعَلَ ٱلنَّهَارَ نُشُورًا
verses.transliteration: Wahuwa alladhī jaʿala lakumu al-layla libāsaw-wal-nawma subātaw-wajaʿala n-nahāra nushūrā
verses.translation: He is the One Who has made the night for you as a cover, and ˹made˺ sleep for resting, and the day for rising

verses.arabicText: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَرْسَلَ ٱلرِّيَـٰحَ بُشْرًۢا بَيْنَ يَدَىْ رَحْمَتِهِۦ ۚ وَأَنزَلْنَا مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءً طَهُورًا
verses.transliteration: Wahuwa alladhī arsala r-riyāḥa bush'ran bayna yaday raḥmatihi wa-anzalnā mina s-samāi māan ṭahūrā
verses.translation: And He is the One Who sends the winds ushering in His mercy, and We send down pure rain from the sky

verses.arabicText: لِّنُحْـِۧىَ بِهِۦ بَلْدَةً مَّيْتًا وَنُسْقِيَهُۥ مِمَّا خَلَقْنَآ أَنْعَـٰمًا وَأَنَاسِىَّ كَثِيرًا
verses.transliteration: Linuḥ'yiya bihi baldatam-maytaw-wanus'qiyahu mimmā khalaqnā anʿāmaw-wa-anāsiyya kathīrā
verses.translation: giving life to a lifeless land, and providing water for countless animals and humans of Our Own creation

verses.arabicText: وَلَقَدْ صَرَّفْنَـٰهُ بَيْنَهُمْ لِيَذَّكَّرُوا۟ فَأَبَىٰٓ أَكْثَرُ ٱلنَّاسِ إِلَّا كُفُورًا
verses.transliteration: Walaqad ṣarrafnāhu baynahum liyadhakkarū fa-abā aktharu n-nāsi illā kufūrā
verses.translation: We certainly disperse it among them so they may be mindful, but most people persist in ungratefulness

verses.arabicText: وَلَوْ شِئْنَا لَبَعَثْنَا فِى كُلِّ قَرْيَةٍ نَّذِيرًا
verses.transliteration: Walaw shi'nā labaʿathnā fī kulli qaryatin-nadhīrā
verses.translation: Had We willed, We could have easily sent a warner to every society

verses.arabicText: فَلَا تُطِعِ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ وَجَـٰهِدْهُم بِهِۦ جِهَادًا كَبِيرًا
verses.transliteration: Falā tuṭiʿi l-kāfirīna wajāhid'hum bihi jihādan kabīrā
verses.translation: So do not yield to the disbelievers, but strive diligently against them with this ˹Quran˺

verses.arabicText: ۞ وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى مَرَجَ ٱلْبَحْرَيْنِ هَـٰذَا عَذْبٌ فُرَاتٌ وَهَـٰذَا مِلْحٌ أُجَاجٌ وَجَعَلَ بَيْنَهُمَا بَرْزَخًا وَحِجْرًا مَّحْجُورًا
verses.transliteration: Wahuwa alladhī maraja l-baḥrayni hādhā ʿadhbun furātuw-wahādhā mil'ḥun ujājuw-wajaʿala baynahumā barzakhaw-waḥij'ram-maḥjūrā
verses.translation: And He is the One Who merges the two bodies of water: one fresh and palatable and the other salty and bitter, placing between them a barrier they cannot cross

verses.arabicText: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ مِنَ ٱلْمَآءِ بَشَرًا فَجَعَلَهُۥ نَسَبًا وَصِهْرًا ۗ وَكَانَ رَبُّكَ قَدِيرًا
verses.transliteration: Wahuwa alladhī khalaqa mina l-māi basharan fajaʿalahu nasabaw-waṣih'raw-wakāna rabbuka qadīrā
verses.translation: And He is the One Who creates human beings from a ˹humble˺ liquid, then establishes for them bonds of kinship and marriage. For your Lord is Most Capable

verses.arabicText: وَيَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا يَنفَعُهُمْ وَلَا يَضُرُّهُمْ ۗ وَكَانَ ٱلْكَافِرُ عَلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ ظَهِيرًا
verses.transliteration: Wayaʿbudūna min dūni l-lahi mā lā yanfaʿuhum walā yaḍurruhum wakāna l-kāfiru ʿalā rabbihi ẓahīrā
verses.translation: Yet they worship besides Allah what can neither benefit nor harm them. And the disbeliever always collaborates against their Lord

verses.arabicText: وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَـٰكَ إِلَّا مُبَشِّرًا وَنَذِيرًا
verses.transliteration: Wamā arsalnāka illā mubashiraw-wanadhīrā
verses.translation: And We have sent you ˹O Prophet˺ only as a deliverer of good news and a warner

verses.arabicText: قُلْ مَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ إِلَّا مَن شَآءَ أَن يَتَّخِذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ سَبِيلًا
verses.transliteration: Qul mā asalukum ʿalayhi min ajrin illā man shāa ay-yattakhidha ilā rabbihi sabīlā
verses.translation: Say, “I do not ask you for any reward for this ˹message˺, but whoever wishes, let them pursue the Way to their Lord.”

verses.arabicText: وَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى ٱلْحَىِّ ٱلَّذِى لَا يَمُوتُ وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِهِۦ ۚ وَكَفَىٰ بِهِۦ بِذُنُوبِ عِبَادِهِۦ خَبِيرًا
verses.transliteration: Watawakkal ʿalā l-ḥayi alladhī lā yamūtu wasabbiḥ biḥamdihi wakafā bihi bidhunūbi ʿibādihi khabīrā
verses.translation: Put your trust in the Ever-Living, Who never dies, and glorify His praises. Sufficient is He as All-Aware of the sins of His servants

verses.arabicText: ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا فِى سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٍ ثُمَّ ٱسْتَوَىٰ عَلَى ٱلْعَرْشِ ۚ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ فَسْـَٔلْ بِهِۦ خَبِيرًا
verses.transliteration: Alladhī khalaqa s-samāwāti wal-arḍa wamā baynahumā fī sittati ayyāmin thumma is'tawā ʿalā l-ʿarshi r-raḥmānu fasal bihi khabīrā
verses.translation: ˹He is˺ the One Who created the heavens and the earth and everything in between in six Days, then established Himself on the Throne. ˹He is˺ the Most Compassionate! Ask ˹none other than˺ the All-Knowledgeable about Himself

verses.arabicText: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمُ ٱسْجُدُوا۟ لِلرَّحْمَـٰنِ قَالُوا۟ وَمَا ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ أَنَسْجُدُ لِمَا تَأْمُرُنَا وَزَادَهُمْ نُفُورًا ۩
verses.transliteration: Wa-idhā qīla lahumu us'judū lilrraḥmāni qālū wamā r-raḥmānu anasjudu limā tamurunā wazādahum nufūrā
verses.translation: When it is said to them, “Prostrate to the Most Compassionate,” they ask ˹in disgust˺, “What is ‘the Most Compassionate’? Will we prostrate to whatever you order us to?” And it only drives them farther away

verses.arabicText: تَبَارَكَ ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ بُرُوجًا وَجَعَلَ فِيهَا سِرَٰجًا وَقَمَرًا مُّنِيرًا
verses.transliteration: Tabāraka alladhī jaʿala fī s-samāi burūjaw-wajaʿala fīhā sirājaw-waqamaram-munīrā
verses.translation: Blessed is the One Who has placed constellations in the sky, as well as a ˹radiant˺ lamp and a luminous moon

verses.arabicText: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ ٱلَّيْلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَ خِلْفَةً لِّمَنْ أَرَادَ أَن يَذَّكَّرَ أَوْ أَرَادَ شُكُورًا
verses.transliteration: Wahuwa alladhī jaʿala al-layla wal-nahāra khil'fatal-liman arāda ay-yadhakkara aw arāda shukūrā
verses.translation: And He is the One Who causes the day and the night to alternate, ˹as a sign˺ for whoever desires to be mindful or to be grateful

verses.arabicText: وَعِبَادُ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ٱلَّذِينَ يَمْشُونَ عَلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ هَوْنًا وَإِذَا خَاطَبَهُمُ ٱلْجَـٰهِلُونَ قَالُوا۟ سَلَـٰمًا
verses.transliteration: Waʿibādu r-raḥmāni alladhīna yamshūna ʿalā l-arḍi hawnaw-wa-idhā khāṭabahumu l-jāhilūna qālū salāmā
verses.translation: The ˹true˺ servants of the Most Compassionate are those who walk on the earth humbly, and when the foolish address them ˹improperly˺, they only respond with peace

verses.arabicText: وَٱلَّذِينَ يَبِيتُونَ لِرَبِّهِمْ سُجَّدًا وَقِيَـٰمًا
verses.transliteration: Wa-alladhīna yabītūna lirabbihim sujjadaw-waqiyāmā
verses.translation: ˹They are˺ those who spend ˹a good portion of˺ the night, prostrating themselves and standing before their Lord

verses.arabicText: وَٱلَّذِينَ يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَا ٱصْرِفْ عَنَّا عَذَابَ جَهَنَّمَ ۖ إِنَّ عَذَابَهَا كَانَ غَرَامًا
verses.transliteration: Wa-alladhīna yaqūlūna rabbanā iṣ'rif ʿannā ʿadhāba jahannama inna ʿadhābahā kāna gharāmā
verses.translation: ˹They are˺ those who pray, “Our Lord! Keep the punishment of Hell away from us, for its punishment is indeed unrelenting

verses.arabicText: إِنَّهَا سَآءَتْ مُسْتَقَرًّا وَمُقَامًا
verses.transliteration: Innahā sāat mus'taqarraw-wamuqāmā
verses.translation: It is certainly an evil place to settle and reside.”

verses.arabicText: وَٱلَّذِينَ إِذَآ أَنفَقُوا۟ لَمْ يُسْرِفُوا۟ وَلَمْ يَقْتُرُوا۟ وَكَانَ بَيْنَ ذَٰلِكَ قَوَامًا
verses.transliteration: Wa-alladhīna idhā anfaqū lam yus'rifū walam yaqturū wakāna bayna dhālika qawāmā
verses.translation: ˹They are˺ those who spend neither wastefully nor stingily, but moderately in between

verses.arabicText: وَٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَدْعُونَ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَـٰهًا ءَاخَرَ وَلَا يَقْتُلُونَ ٱلنَّفْسَ ٱلَّتِى حَرَّمَ ٱللَّهُ إِلَّا بِٱلْحَقِّ وَلَا يَزْنُونَ ۚ وَمَن يَفْعَلْ ذَٰلِكَ يَلْقَ أَثَامًا
verses.transliteration: Wa-alladhīna lā yadʿūna maʿa l-lahi ilāhan ākhara walā yaqtulūna n-nafsa allatī ḥarrama l-lahu illā bil-ḥaqi walā yaznūna wamay-yafʿal dhālika yalqa athāmā
verses.translation: ˹They are˺ those who do not invoke any other god besides Allah, nor take a ˹human˺ life—made sacred by Allah—except with ˹legal˺ right, nor commit fornication. And whoever does ˹any of˺ this will face the penalty

verses.arabicText: يُضَـٰعَفْ لَهُ ٱلْعَذَابُ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ وَيَخْلُدْ فِيهِۦ مُهَانًا
verses.transliteration: Yuḍāʿaf lahu l-ʿadhābu yawma l-qiyāmati wayakhlud fīhi muhānā
verses.translation: Their punishment will be multiplied on the Day of Judgment, and they will remain in it forever, in disgrace

verses.arabicText: إِلَّا مَن تَابَ وَءَامَنَ وَعَمِلَ عَمَلًا صَـٰلِحًا فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ يُبَدِّلُ ٱللَّهُ سَيِّـَٔاتِهِمْ حَسَنَـٰتٍ ۗ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ غَفُورًا رَّحِيمًا
verses.transliteration: Illā man tāba waāmana waʿamila ʿamalan ṣāliḥan fa-ulāika yubaddilu l-lahu sayyiātihim ḥasanātiw-wakāna l-lahu ghafūrar-raḥīmā
verses.translation: As for those who repent, believe, and do good deeds, they are the ones whose evil deeds Allah will change into good deeds. For Allah is All-Forgiving, Most Merciful

verses.arabicText: وَمَن تَابَ وَعَمِلَ صَـٰلِحًا فَإِنَّهُۥ يَتُوبُ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ مَتَابًا
verses.transliteration: Waman tāba waʿamila ṣāliḥan fa-innahu yatūbu ilā l-lahi matābā
verses.translation: And whoever repents and does good has truly turned to Allah properly

verses.arabicText: وَٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَشْهَدُونَ ٱلزُّورَ وَإِذَا مَرُّوا۟ بِٱللَّغْوِ مَرُّوا۟ كِرَامًا
verses.transliteration: Wa-alladhīna lā yashhadūna z-zūra wa-idhā marrū bil-laghwi marrū kirāmā
verses.translation: ˹They are˺ those who do not bear false witness, and when they come across falsehood, they pass ˹it˺ by with dignity

verses.arabicText: وَٱلَّذِينَ إِذَا ذُكِّرُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ لَمْ يَخِرُّوا۟ عَلَيْهَا صُمًّا وَعُمْيَانًا
verses.transliteration: Wa-alladhīna idhā dhukkirū biāyāti rabbihim lam yakhirrū ʿalayhā ṣummaw-waʿum'yānā
verses.translation: ˹They are˺ those who, when reminded of the revelation of their Lord, do not turn a blind eye or a deaf ear to it

verses.arabicText: وَٱلَّذِينَ يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَا هَبْ لَنَا مِنْ أَزْوَٰجِنَا وَذُرِّيَّـٰتِنَا قُرَّةَ أَعْيُنٍ وَٱجْعَلْنَا لِلْمُتَّقِينَ إِمَامًا
verses.transliteration: Wa-alladhīna yaqūlūna rabbanā hab lanā min azwājinā wadhurriyyātinā qurrata aʿyuniw-wa-ij'ʿalnā lil'muttaqīna imāmā
verses.translation: ˹They are˺ those who pray, “Our Lord! Bless us with ˹pious˺ spouses and offspring who will be the joy of our hearts, and make us models for the righteous.”

verses.arabicText: أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ يُجْزَوْنَ ٱلْغُرْفَةَ بِمَا صَبَرُوا۟ وَيُلَقَّوْنَ فِيهَا تَحِيَّةً وَسَلَـٰمًا
verses.transliteration: Ulāika yuj'zawna l-ghur'fata bimā ṣabarū wayulaqqawna fīhā taḥiyyataw-wasalāmā
verses.translation: It is they who will be rewarded with ˹elevated˺ mansions ˹in Paradise˺ for their perseverance, and will be received with salutations and ˹greetings of˺ peace

verses.arabicText: خَـٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا ۚ حَسُنَتْ مُسْتَقَرًّا وَمُقَامًا
verses.transliteration: Khālidīna fīhā ḥasunat mus'taqarraw-wamuqāmā
verses.translation: staying there forever. What an excellent place to settle and reside

verses.arabicText: قُلْ مَا يَعْبَؤُا۟ بِكُمْ رَبِّى لَوْلَا دُعَآؤُكُمْ ۖ فَقَدْ كَذَّبْتُمْ فَسَوْفَ يَكُونُ لِزَامًۢا
verses.transliteration: Qul mā yaʿba-u bikum rabbī lawlā duʿāukum faqad kadhabtum fasawfa yakūnu lizāmā
verses.translation: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “You ˹all˺ would not ˹even˺ matter to my Lord were it not for your faith ˹in Him˺. But now you ˹disbelievers˺ have denied ˹the truth˺, so the torment is bound to come.”
